title: xUnit execution totals
interpretation: 313 total: 310 passed, 1 failed, 2 skipped. Exit code 1. Skips include live-provider transport and the evidence-host harness.

title: DEF-12: spoofed PDF rejection fails
interpretation: Expected ArgumentException was not thrown for 32 inert ASCII bytes beginning MZ, supplied as sample.pdf/application/pdf. DEF-12 remains OPEN; no successful remediation retest exists.

title: React project: Node test output
interpretation: The actual npm run test:member1 execution passed all 19 subtests. These are Node routing/helper checks, not React Testing Library component tests.

title: Flutter machine runner: successful completion
interpretation: Visible final widget cases succeed and the runner reports success=true. The full machine stream contains 49 visible unit/widget tests across six files; no device or integrated workflow is inferred.

title: Playwright HTML execution report
interpretation: 109 passed and three skipped, across 14 specification files (112 cases). The report All tab excludes skipped cases. Most tests intercept API requests with mocks.

title: Actual React schedule editor under Playwright
interpretation: Focused browser view of the preserved application screenshot. Weekly hours, duration and synthetic 2030 leave data are visible. API responses were mocked: this is UI evidence, not the blocked Flutter-to-clerk E2E workflow.

title: OWASP ZAP passive scan summary
interpretation: Six deliberate requests to isolated loopback HTTP; no active scan or spider. Two alert types: one Low and one Informational. Zero High/Medium alerts in this scope does not establish absence of vulnerabilities.

title: ZAP alert instances and missing-header detail
interpretation: The Low missing X-Content-Type-Options alert has three instances; authentication discovery has one Informational instance. Fixture headers differ from full production startup. The report false-positive count is not a manual disposition.

title: k6 controlled local execution completes
interpretation: Actual output records completion of 20 iterations with two VUs over ten seconds. The fixture used EF InMemory and mocked AI; PostgreSQL and live Gemini performance were not measured.

title: k6 original machine metrics
interpretation: HTTP failure rate is 0 across 81 requests. Appointment-list p50 is 1.263 ms, p95 23.507 ms, average 3.473 ms. The rate metric fails=81 means 81 false samples for http_req_failed, not 81 failed requests.

title: Coverlet results displayed by ReportGenerator
interpretation: Line coverage is 23%. Coverlet XML root records 48.91% branches (1326/2711); ReportGenerator displays 48.7% (1293/2655) after its own aggregation. Both originals are retained; this rendering is not a new execution or coverage increase.

title: pytest deterministic and mocked AI suite
interpretation: 98 passed, with nine warnings. Synthetic provider initialization and mocked/deterministic tests do not demonstrate live Gemini accuracy, Golden Case success or response latency.

title: GitHub Actions: historical Mobile CI success
interpretation: The real GitHub page shows Success for base commit 8a9b8a2, duration 2m18s. It does not cover uncommitted local test additions; other recorded runs failed. Job logs require sign-in.
